Required question: What clinical, economic, and real-world evidence supports the product?
Will the vendor support validation using local hospital data?
Does the system support open standards and integration with existing infrastructure?
Who owns input data, output data, logs, derived data, and model-improvement data?
Can the hospital audit performance, bias, usage, and safety?
How are model updates documented, tested, and approved?
What security certifications, controls, and incident response procedures are in place?
Are future fees, maintenance costs, and integration costs predictable?
Can the hospital export data and discontinue without vendor lock-in?
What decisions require human review and accountability?
